faq-great-dynamic.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq-great-dynamic.description: Find answers to common queries about our courses, admissions, and campus life at LCC Campus.

faqItems.question: What courses does LCC Campus offer?
faqItems.answer: We offer skill development courses in Computer Applications, Fashion Designing, Hospital Administration, Pre-primary TTC, and Beautician programs, designed to equip students with practical, industry-relevant skills.

faqItems.question: Where are your campuses located?
faqItems.answer: LCC Campus has multiple branches across Kerala, including Edakkara, Nilambur, Pothukal, and Karulai, making quality education accessible to students throughout the region.

faqItems.question: How can I apply for admission?
faqItems.answer: You can contact us via phone at 9744064081 or email johnsonlccedk@gmail.com. Our team will guide you through the application process, course details, and enrollment steps.

faqItems.question: Are your courses certified?
faqItems.answer: Yes, all our programs provide professional certification upon successful completion, helping you build a strong foundation for your career in your chosen field.

faqItems.question: Do you offer placement assistance?
faqItems.answer: We provide career guidance and support to help students transition into the workforce, including interview preparation and connections with industry partners.
